_readme: Home page comparison: the same page of the same HWPX file as Hancom 한글 and Ttoryeot (또렷) render it, side by side. Run python3 _products/compare-gen.py after editing. Only verified renders from the 또렷 PM go here (source: OpenBot Shared/207/preview-compare/assets/README.md and SHA256SUMS, delivered 2026-11-03): both PNGs must be the same page, the same pixel size, unedited. With no samples the section is not rendered. Paths are site paths under /assets/apps/ttoryeot/compare/.

caption.en: The same page of the same document, as rendered by Hancom 한글 12.30.0 (Mac) and by 또렷, unedited.
caption.ko: 같은 문서의 같은 쪽을 한글 12.30.0(Mac)과 또렷으로 그린 그대로입니다.

method.en: Hancom Office HWP for Mac 12.30.0 exported its PDF on 2026-11-01 (File › Save as PDF); 또렷 0.1.0 (commit 751dfbe) rendered its PDF on 2026-11-03 with the same Hancom fonts. Both PDFs were turned into 1240×1754 PNGs (150 dpi) with the same tool on 2026-11-03; nothing is cropped or retouched. The Hancom image comes from Hancom's PDF export, not a screenshot of the Hancom window. These are short synthetic test pages written by the 또렷 project, not real-world forms.
method.ko: 한글(한컴오피스 HWP for Mac 12.30.0)은 2026-11-01에 ‘PDF로 저장하기’로 PDF를 만들었고, 또렷 0.1.0(커밋 751dfbe)은 2026-11-03에 같은 한글 글꼴로 PDF를 그렸어요. 두 PDF는 2026-11-03에 같은 도구로 1240×1754 PNG(150dpi)로 바꿨고, 자르거나 손대지 않았어요. 한글 쪽 그림은 한글 창을 찍은 화면이 아니라 한글이 내보낸 PDF에서 나왔어요. 또렷 프로젝트가 만든 짧은 시험용 문서이고, 실제 서식 문서는 아니에요.
